description.text: The ninth expansion, released on 11 December 2015, with a red, shiny Mega Gyarados on the wrapper. M Gyarados-EX made its card debut here with an attack that can knock out even an M Pokémon in one hit. Greninja BREAK, Trevenant BREAK and Raticate BREAK, M Scizor-EX, and Darkrai-EX, Espeon-EX, Manaphy-EX and Ho-Oh-EX join it. In the XY BREAK story, this is where the towns of Blue Shock and Red Flash became connected. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 80, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and an Ultra Rare gold, shiny Gyarados-EX. In English most of its cards came out in BREAKpoint in February 2016.
